ATLAS-side docstring edit not in formal-math: the IsOneTreeIn docstring says that SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet drops diagonal pairs from the members not at v0 while the count at v0 is taken on the raw set, and that the loop-free 1-tree reading applies when A consists of edges of K_n, as in IsSuccessiveShortest. No statement changes.

ATLAS-side docstring edit not in formal-math: the RaysEquiv docstring says the predicate accepts arbitrary sequences and keeps the one-component reading for rays, and the IsEndRay and Devours docstrings say that the reference sequence r0 is not tested to be a ray (r0 n = 2 * n on the one-way infinite path is equivalent to the ray s n = n). No statement changes.

ATLAS-side docstring edit not in formal-math (#9876): the docstrings state the normalisation and counting conventions of their definitions (Set.ncard and Nat.card give 0 on infinite sets; ENNReal inverts 0 to infinity). No statement changes. Also: the WassersteinStepAtMostOne docstring reads the predicate as a coupling inequality (unreachable pairs at distance 0, rows not always probability vectors) that means W1 <= 1 only within a component without isolated vertices, and the SecondEigenvalueAtMost docstring reads it as a degree-weighted quadratic-form bound, the lambda_2 bound for a connected graph on at least two vertices.
